title: CustomerList NewCustomerPanel close button missing data-testid
detail: CustomerList NewCustomerPanel close button (line 178) — the close button was missing data-testid.
recommendedFix: Add data-testid='cust-btn-close-panel' to the close button.

title: CustomerList useEffect dep on showAll re-fetches entire list — no $top cap
detail: Line 33: `useEffect(() => { loadCustomers(); }, [showAll]);` re-fetches all customers whenever the 'Show inactive' checkbox toggles. Line 40: the apiGet has no $top cap.
evidence: CustomerList.jsx:40 — apiGet with no $top. Line 33 — re-fetch on showAll toggle.
recommendedFix: Add `&$top=500` (or an appropriate cap) to the apiGet query string.

title: NewCustomerPanel duplicate check swallows errors silently — catch block is empty
detail: Line 140: `} catch {}` after the duplicate-name check apiGet. If the duplicate check fails (e.g., network error, 403), the empty catch means the code proceeds silently to create the customer WITHOUT the dup warning.
evidence: CustomerList.jsx:140 — empty catch block after duplicate check.
recommendedFix: At minimum log the error. Better: show a non-blocking toast like 'Could not check for duplicates — proceeding with save'.

title: NewCustomerPanel creates customer even after detecting a duplicate — warning shown AFTER creation
detail: Line 139: `if (dup?.value?.length > 0) setDupWarn(...)` sets a warning state, but execution falls through to the creation block at line 141. The customer is created regardless of the duplicate. The user should be prompted BEFORE creation to confirm they want a duplicate.
evidence: CustomerList.jsx:136-151 — dup check then unconditional create. Warning says 'Record was still created.'
recommendedFix: Show the duplicate warning BEFORE creating and require user confirmation to proceed.

title: Search input lacks an associated <label> for screen readers
detail: Line 56-61: the search input has a placeholder but no associated <label> element or aria-label attribute. Screen readers will announce it as an unlabeled text field.
evidence: CustomerList.jsx:56 — <input ... placeholder='Search customers...'> with no aria-label or <label for>.
recommendedFix: Add `aria-label='Search customers'` to the search input.

title: CustomerList table rows with onClick lack keyboard accessibility
detail: Line 91: each <tr> has `onClick={() => navigate(...)}` but table rows have no native keyboard behavior. Users navigating with Tab cannot reach or activate these rows.
evidence: CustomerList.jsx:91 — <tr ... onClick={...}> with no tabIndex or onKeyDown.
recommendedFix: Add `tabIndex={0}` and `onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') navigate(...); }}` to each clickable <tr>. Alternatively, wrap the primary column content in a <Link> component.
